taxonomy_note: Analyst planning lens; reassess actual root cause.

controls.boundary: LDAP filter and distinguished-name injection — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read filter and distinguished-name construction separately, including library escaping APIs and directory search scope. Establish who controls each interpolated component.
controls.controlled_verification: With a local directory fixture, compare a legitimate account value with punctuation that must remain literal in that component. Inspect the serialized filter/DN and returned fixture entries. If input reaches both contexts, evaluate both representations rather than reusing one escaping rule.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A rejected malformed filter is not an authentication bypass. Correct filter escaping does not establish DN safety, and a parameter-like API name needs its actual library contract checked.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use the library's context-appropriate builder/escaping and constrain directory search authority. Retest valid special-character account names and the original query-selection discrepancy.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
